author: Bloomberg
title: Gold, silver slip at end of record-setting year for precious metals
description: Gold and silver experience a year-end dip after record highs, closing 2025 with historic performances despite recent profit-taking.
content:
Gold and silver fell in the last trading day of 2025, though both remained on track for record annual performances as a banner year for precious metals draws to a close.
